risks: Supplier cost is 33% of the proposed price, above the ~29% guide for out-of-Odisha (website-only) suppliers; may land BELOW_TARGET
Retail comparables come from a third-party tracker whose data ends early 2026; live Amazon.in/Flipkart prices must be re-checked before listing
Exact kit contents of the Rs 264 listing unknown; if it includes candles or a lighter it needs checking (no lighter or flammable liquid allowed); confirm wax is sticks/beads
Supplier in Surat, Gujarat: website-only per docs/05; single-piece drop-ship, MOQ and dispatch time need a written quote

GST/HSN (stamp 9611 vs sealing wax 3404) to be confirmed by the CA; 18% used as a conservative figure

review.notes: Rs 799 is not supported by current evidence: the only verified generic gift-box comparable (Supvox, Rs 839) is tracker data ending early 2026, while a generic Curated Cart wax seal kit tracks on Amazon.in at avg Rs 313 / low Rs 253 (May 2026) and no live Flipkart or Meesho price exists; at Rs 799 margin is only 31.2% (fragile, website-only) and at a more defensible Rs 599 it falls to ~10% (Rs 47/order), Rs 499 is loss-making. Secondary: Rs 264 kit contents unknown and most kits ship tea-light candles (lighter must be excluded), plus summer wax deformation.
